title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in Excel with Python for GCC High
description: Copilot in Excel gains powerful new insights and visualizations with Advanced Analysis. Explore your data in a natural, conversational way, while Copilot does the heavy lifting using Python, a rich programming language that supercharges what is possible in your spreadsheets.
